projects.name: VERUM
projects.summary: VERUM developed an architecture for reliable environment perception in urban air mobility. It brought together AI, multimodal sensing, and semantic mapping to help aircraft understand their surroundings.
contributions: Curated aerial datasets and trained semantic and panoptic segmentation models.
Used a custom version of Radix as an end user and shared feedback during its development. This version now serves as a foundation for ENGEL.
Co-developed SSP to improve temporal consistency in aerial semantic segmentation.

projects.name: NiKoLaS
projects.tagline: Detecting obstacles that do not announce themselves.
projects.summary: NiKoLaS investigates collision avoidance close to the ground, especially during takeoff and landing. Radar and infrared sensing help detect hazards such as cranes, vehicles, and people, including obstacles that do not transmit their position.
contributions: Acquired and processed aerial datasets, and trained segmentation models for an infrared-only scene-parsing pipeline.
Integrated DAV3 metric depth estimation into the perception pipeline.
Provided perception outputs that are fused with dynamic obstacle detections for downstream motion forecasting.

projects.name: ADAM
projects.tagline: High-definition maps for the lower airspace.
projects.summary: ADAM (Advanced Air Space Mapping) develops detailed, semantically annotated 3D maps for safer drone operations. It connects aerial data collection and mapping with localization, flight planning, and airspace services.
contributions: Acquired, processed, and annotated aerial datasets, and trained segmentation models for offline and live 3D map building.
Co-developed MultiFly for efficient multimodal dataset creation through RGB-to-X label propagation across heterogeneous sensors.
Used VoxelFix to clean up semantic artifacts in the resulting 3D maps.
Presented our work on high-definition 3D semantic mapping, including map-based pre-flight checks of planned flight paths, and participated in the project’s demo flights.

projects.name: ENGEL
projects.tagline: Helping rescue helicopters land in unfamiliar terrain.
projects.summary: ENGEL explores sensing and AI assistance for rescue helicopters. Better awareness of terrain and obstacles supports flight, approach, and landing, with the aim of making demanding missions safer and more efficient.
contributions: Developing semantic scene parsing and landing-spot detection for aerial environments.
Fusing static satellite-map information with live Radix maps to support downstream tasks.
Refining the Radix-based mapping and map-serving pipeline for real-time on-board use, and optimizing segmentation models through quantization and deployment with TensorRT and Triton.
Setting up hardware-in-the-loop testing in CI/CD using an Orin runner.
Designing ROS2Bench interfaces between upstream and downstream components.
